description: Find the Heathy slug for a food or Ayurvedic herb by name, including regional and non-English aliases (Hindi, Sanskrit, botanical names). Resolves a plain-English or local name to the slug that lookup_food and herb_monograph accept. Returns ranked candidates rather than guessing a single answer.

kind.description: Restrict to foods or Ayurvedic herbs. Default "any".

query.description: Name, partial name, or alias — e.g. "haldi", "bitter gou".

name: search_foods
title: Search foods and herbs
